key_idea: Simulate: cast rays from every bulb in four directions until a blocked cell, then check the three rules directly.
sketch: For each bulb walk in the 4 directions over open/bulb cells, marking them lit; meeting another bulb is a violation. For each digit cell count orthogonally adjacent bulbs and compare. Finally every '.' must be lit. O(n^3) worst case with n<=30. Pitfalls: bulbs light themselves, X cells have no constraint, a grid with no open cells is valid.
